title: Stop Saying "Very Hungry"! 4 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very hungry". Say one of these instead:
• Starving: I'm starving!
• Famished: We were famished after the hike.
• Ravenous: I was ravenous by lunchtime.
• The idiom: I could eat a horse!
